description: This file contains utility functions for traversing permission graphs, including splitting permission strings, and finding dependencies and dependents of permissions within a specified scope.

methods.name: splitPermission
methods.description: Splits a permission string into resource and action parts, handling dotted notation.

methods.name: traversePermissions
methods.description: Performs a BFS traversal to find dependencies or dependents of a given permission.

methods.name: getTransitiveDependencies
methods.description: Returns all permissions that the specified permission transitively depends on.

methods.name: getTransitiveDependents
methods.description: Returns all permissions that transitively depend on the specified permission.
